name: GarageFlow - Technical - ${ENVIRONMENT}
description: API and Kubernetes telemetry. Lambda execution and business status-duration indicators are outside this dashboard. Missing data does not mean healthy uptime. Validate queries against received telemetry before acceptance.

pages.name: API
pages.description: HTTP metrics cover all measured requests; traces may be sampled. Health probes are not a measure of external availability.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT percentile(http.server.request.duration, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT rate(count(http.server.request.duration), 1 minute) WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' TIMESERIES

FROM Metric SELECT 100 * filter(count(http.server.request.duration), WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500) / count(http.server.request.duration) WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95) WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' FACET http.route LIMIT 30
FROM Log SELECT timestamp, message, trace.id, span.id WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' LIMIT 30

widgets.title: Recent server spans (sampled, not total traffic)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT timestamp, name, duration.ms, trace.id, id, http.response.status_code WHERE service.name = 'garageflow-api' AND deployment.environment.name = '${ENVIRONMENT}' AND span.kind = 'server' LIMIT 30

pages.name: Kubernetes
pages.description: Container usage aggregated by node from the pinned NRDOT chart LowDataMode pipeline, relative to allocatable capacity. Host overhead can differ from kubectl top nodes. Use Kubernetes Navigator for pod, deployment and HPA detail. Validate received metrics before acceptance.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(node.cpu.usage.percentage) * 100 WHERE k8s.cluster.name = 'garageflow-${ENVIRONMENT}' FACET k8s.node.name TIMESERIES
FROM Metric SELECT average(node.memory.usage.percentage) * 100 WHERE k8s.cluster.name = 'garageflow-${ENVIRONMENT}' FACET k8s.node.name TIMESERIES
